subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 09/10] mountd: drop a deferred fsid lookup once it has been answered

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service in NFS-utils to remove a deferred file system ID (fsid) lookup once it has been answered. The patch addresses an issue where building an expkey batch can defer an entry, leading to duplicate answers from the retry queue. It introduces two new functions: `delayed_expkey_matches` and `delayed_expkey_remove`, which enable efficient removal of deferred entries from the queue. This change ensures that each entry is only answered once, preventing unnecessary retries and improving overall performance.
